latest.title: Limiting Bedrock Usage and Controlling Costs
latest.description: This post compares three approaches to controlling Bedrock costs — critical for agentic development — including CloudWatch Alarms with Lambda for near-real-time IAM-based blocking, AWS Budgets with cost allocation tags for lightweight alerting and forecasting, and an app-layer gateway for synchronous per-user enforcement before a single token is consumed.

latest.title: Running OpenClaw and Hermes Agent on a Single Amazon EC2 - A Developer's Guide
latest.description: A step-by-step guide to running OpenClaw and Hermes Agent simultaneously on a single Amazon EC2 t4g.xlarge instance, each connected to a separate WeChat account and sharing the same Amazon Bedrock backend (Claude Opus 4.6). latest.title: From Paper Pile to Patient Priority: Building a Clinical Document Triage Agent with Amazon Bedrock and Textract
latest.description: This article walks through how to build a Clinical Document Triage Agent using Amazon Textract and Amazon Comprehend Medical, orchestrated by an Amazon Bedrock Agent. The result: instead of reading forty documents, a nurse reviews a ranked worklist with plain-English rationale for each patient — generated automatically as documents arrive.

latest.title: Governing the Agent Control Plane on AWS: RAR, RSI, and DCS — The Three SLIs Amazon Bedrock Orchestration Needs
latest.description: Amazon Bedrock Agents now supports multi-agent collaboration, enabling orchestrator agents to decompose tasks and route subtasks across specialist agents. This architecture introduces a new reliability layer: the agent control plane the orchestration logic that manages task decomposition, agent routing, retry behavior, and priority queuing across your entire Bedrock agent fleet.
